home.programText: A little longer each day you practise. A missed day just waits for you.
home.backupText: A free account keeps your practice safe across devices.
home.install: Keep Gvozdi on your home screen
home.installText: Opens full screen and works offline.
home.installIos: Tap Share, then “Add to Home Screen”. Opens full screen and works offline.

settings.title: Settings
settings.dataText: Sessions live on this device only. Export a backup to keep them safe or move them to another phone.
settings.importFailed: That file isn't a Gvozdi backup.
settings.clearText: Your whole history, streak and achievements will be gone. Export a backup first if you might want them back.
settings.contactText: Questions, ideas or a bug? Write to us on Telegram.
settings.reminderText: A gentle nudge at the same time every day.
settings.reminderWeb: Reminders work in the iOS and Android app.
settings.reminderDenied: Notifications are off. Allow them in your phone's settings.
settings.dataTextSynced: Sessions are backed up to your account. You can still export a JSON copy any time.

hints.peak: Guides you through the sharp first minutes.
hints.timed: A quiet countdown to your goal.
hints.free: A stopwatch. Step off when you are ready.

session.prepareText: Relax. Take a deep breath. As you exhale, stand on the nails. For the first few minutes, there may be discomfort in the feet. Take a deep breath and exhale to relax. Soon the pain will pass and the real practice will begin…

captions.sharp: Sharp now. That's the nerve, not harm. Breathe out slowly.
captions.climbing: Climbing to the peak. Don't shift your weight — let it come.
captions.top: This is the top. It only eases from here.
captions.past: Past the worst. Feel the sting loosening.
captions.adapting: The body adapts. It's getting easier.
captions.goal: Goal reached. Keep going or finish.

session.notifyBody: {{min}} min on the board. Step off when you are ready.
session.discardText: {{time}} on the board won't be saved.

history.title: History
history.emptyText: Your practice will gather here, day by day.
history.deleteText: This {{time}} session will be removed from your history and stats.

streak_100.title: Century
streak_100.desc: One hundred days in a row

welcome.title: Stand on nails. Calmly.
welcome.text: A timer, a streak, and a few honest words about how it felt. Nothing else.

peak.title: Sharp, then it eases.
peak.text: Discomfort peaks around a minute and a half, then fades. Breathe out slowly and let it pass. Peak mode walks you through it.

start.title: A few minutes a day.
start.text: Begin short and add a little as your feet adapt. Everything stays on this device; no account needed.
start.safety: If you are pregnant, have diabetes, a heart condition or wounds on your feet, ask your doctor first.

reminder.title: Time for the board
reminder.body: A few quiet minutes on the nails.

account.title: Account
account.intro: Enter your email. We'll send a code: no password needed. New here? This creates your free account.
account.badCode: That code isn't right. Try again.
account.expired: That code expired. Ask for a new one.
account.failed: Something went wrong. Check your connection and try again.
account.syncedText: Your sessions sync to this account automatically.
account.guestCaption: You're practising as a guest. Sessions live only on this device.
account.signedInCaption: Signed in as {{email}}. Sessions sync automatically.
account.offerText: Create a free account and your sessions and streak will be backed up and on every device you use.
